title: Italian Air Force chief introduces Malmgren's book

tellings.quote: one of the people introducing the book was the chief of the Italian air force

plain: Harald Malmgren, who says he once advised US presidents, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a book of his presented in Italy in 2025. He says one of the people who introduced the book was the head of the Italian Air Force. If true, it would show that senior military figures take his work seriously.
